<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>

class CF1187G {
public:
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    // Fast input scanner
    class Scanner {
    public:
        Scanner() : in(stdin) {}
        Scanner(FILE* f) : in(f) {}
        int nextInt() {
            char c = 0;
            while (c <= 32) c = getc();
            int a = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                a = a * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = getc();
            }
            return a;
        }
    private:
        FILE* in;
        char getc() {
            return getchar_unlocked();
        }
    };

    Scanner sc;

    // Member variables
    int n_, m_, t, k_, c_, d_;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> aa_;
    std::vector<int> pi, dd, bb, uu, vv, uv, cost, cc;
    std::vector<int> qq;
    std::vector<char> iq;
    int head, cnt, nq;

    CF1187G() : sc(stdin), nq(1 << 20), head(0), cnt(0) {}

    void init() {
        aa_.resize(n_);
        for (int u = 0; u < n_; ++u)
            aa_[u].clear();
        pi.assign(n_, INF);
        dd.assign(n_, INF);
        bb.assign(n_, 0);
        qq.assign(nq, 0);
        iq.assign(n_, 0);
        uu.assign(m_, 0);
        vv.assign(m_, 0);
        uv.assign(m_, 0);
        cost.assign(m_, 0);
        cc.assign(m_ * 2, 0);
        m_ = 0;
    }

    void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_++;
        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cc[h << 1] = cap;
        aa_[u].push_back(h << 1);
        aa_[v].push_back(h << 1 | 1);
    }

    void enqueue(int v) {
        if (iq[v]) return;
        if (head + cnt >= nq) {
            if (cnt * 2 <= nq) {
                memmove(&qq[0], &qq[head], cnt * sizeof(int));
            } else {
                nq *= 2;
                std::vector<int> new_qq(nq);
                memcpy(&new_qq[0], &qq[head], cnt * sizeof(int));
                qq.swap(new_qq);
            }
            head = 0;
        }
        qq[head + cnt] = v;
        cnt++;
        iq[v] = 1;
    }

    int dequeue() {
        int u = qq[head++];
        cnt--;
        iq[u] = 0;
        return u;
    }

    bool spfa(int s, int t) {
        std::fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        std::fill(dd.begin(), dd.end(), INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        dd[s] = 0;
        head = cnt = 0;
        enqueue(s);
        while (cnt > 0) {
            int u = dequeue();
            int d = dd[u] + 1;
            const std::vector<int>& adj = aa_[u];
            for (int h_ : adj) {
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost[h] : -cost[h]);
                    int v = u ^ uv[h];
                    if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && dd[v] > d)) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        dd[v] = d;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        enqueue(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pi[t] != INF;
    }

    void push1(int s, int t) {
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h_ = bb[u];
            h = h_ >> 1;
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        while (spfa(s, t))
            push1(s, t);
        int c = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; ++h) {
            c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 | 1];
        }
        return c;
    }

    void main() {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        std::vector<int> ii(k);
        for (int h = 0; h < k; ++h) {
            ii[h] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> aa(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            aa[i].clear();

        for (int h = 0; h < m; ++h) {
            int i = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            aa[i].push_back(j);
            aa[j].push_back(i);
        }

        int t = n + k + 1;
        n_ = n * t + 1;
        m_ = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (t - 1);
        init();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const std::vector<int>& adj = aa[i];
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; ++s) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : adj) {
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; ++x) {
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; ++s) {
                int u = i * t + s, v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, (i == 0) ? 0 : c);
            }
        }

        for (int h = 0; h < k; ++h) {
            link(n_ - 1, ii[h] * t, 1, 0);
        }

        std::cout << edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1) << std::endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.main();
    return 0;
}
